requirements.reason: WinUI 3 content area renders completely blank. 0/5 controls present (four Prefer* checkboxes + Apply preferences button absent from UIA tree and screenshot); all output text absent. UIA tree contains the error 'Navigation to DisplayOrientation.Scenario1_Orientation failed: Object reference not set to an instance of an object.'
requirements.suspected_skill_gap: NullReferenceException from App.MainWindow!.AppWindow read in Scenario1.OnNavigatedTo while App.MainWindow is still null during MainWindow construction. The scaffold navigates from the ctor; the init-order rule IS documented (dev-agent slip), but two skill weaknesses let it ship: (1) the init-order section wrongly claims the smoke launch catches the race — it does not when the throw is swallowed by a nested scenario frame; (2) DisplayInformation.AutoRotationPreferences is a second, undetected runtime trap.

summary: Clean build + green smoke launch masked a total content-rendering failure. Primary cause: null-static init-order race (App.MainWindow read during MainWindow ctor via nested scenario-frame navigation) throwing an NRE that the nested Frame swallowed. Secondary latent cause: DisplayInformation.AutoRotationPreferences runtime trap.
